name: Seed 2.2 Pro
archDisplay: Proprietary multimodal flagship in the Doubao Seed line; 256K-token context
note: ByteDance's September 10, 2026 Seed 2.2 Pro — the second-quarterly bump to the Doubao Seed line (2.1 Pro was June 24). $0.90/$4.40 per Mtok keeps it far under every Western frontier price while the launch table pushes the vision/agentic rows ByteDance always leads with: Video-MME Pro 90.4 (a new revision it co-announces), OSWorld 3.0 74.6, MathVision 93.1. Text-side reasoning rows improve by 1.5-2.5 points across the board. As with Seed 2.1, the numbers are vendor-run but the suite is broad and consistent with ByteDance's published cadence.
